evaluation_role: Retrospective interval experiment specified after inspecting point-forecast holdout results; not a fresh independent test
method: Fixed per-model, per-horizon absolute-residual quantile bands
calibration_source: Earlier validation predictions only; common cutoff no later than the earliest four-week holdout origin
quantile: Sorted absolute residual at one-based rank ceil((n+1)*level/100); refuse rank beyond n
guarantee: No guaranteed coverage: temporal dependence, distribution shift, and model selection share earlier seasons
publication: Does not change point forecasts, model selection, or publication gate; future projections stay subject to the existing point-forecast gate
